HADESANCIENTS-HESTIA_ANCIENT.title: Hestia
HADESANCIENTS-HESTIA_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.0-: Ah, let's burn it all down, what say you, dearie?
HADESANCIENTS-HESTIA_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.1-: We'll turn that flicker in your step into a roaring flame!
HADESANCIENTS-HESTIA_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.2-: What say we make a cozy little fire, then put all our enemies in it?
HADESANCIENTS-HESTIA_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.3-: Looks like we've got a properly hot night ahead of us!
HADESANCIENTS-HESTIA_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.4-: Everything's going to be covered in soot by the time we're through!
HADESANCIENTS-HESTIA_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.5-: Don't let the fire in your heart sputter out, all right?
HADESANCIENTS-HESTIA_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.6-: Hoh, let's have a look and get you good and fired up again, dearie!
HADESANCIENTS-HESTIA_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.7-: All right, hot stuff! We're turning up the temperature to get things roaring, then!
HADESANCIENTS-HESTIA_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.8-: Been far too long since we incinerated stuff together, hasn't it?
HADESANCIENTS-HESTIA_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.9-: Sometimes, you just have to burn everything to the ground and go from there, hot stuff.
HADESANCIENTS-HESTIA_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.10: Sure everything's rotten, but between you and me, I've not felt this alive in some time!
HADESANCIENTS-HESTIA_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.11: They say never to play with fire, dearie. But you have my permission to go right ahead!
HADESANCIENTS-HESTIA_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.12: Time to turn the heat up to full blast, isn't that right, dearie?
HADESANCIENTS-HESTIA_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.13: Got another little warm-up for you right here, hot stuff!
HADESANCIENTS-HESTIA_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.14: Must be cold down in your whereabouts... but not for long!
HADESANCIENTS-HESTIA_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.15: I'm here again, dearie, so cozy up as we're about to have a real blast!
HADESANCIENTS-HESTIA_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.16: This old flame can never be put out, and don't you forget it, dearie!
HADESANCIENTS-HESTIA_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.17: Oh, if I could only roast more of our blasted enemies myself!
HADESANCIENTS-HESTIA_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.18: Warmest wishes to you, dearie, and a little something extra on the side!
HADESANCIENTS-HESTIA_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.19: Some evening, mayhaps you'll settle down to a nice comfortable life, but ohh, not tonight!
HADESANCIENTS-HESTIA_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.20: Sacrifices sometimes must be made, dearie. So round them up and put them to the flame!
HADESANCIENTS-HESTIA_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.21: We're in for a hot one this evening, oh I can already tell!
HADESANCIENTS-HESTIA_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.22: You burn proper hot even without my aid, but with it, oh, hohoho!
HADESANCIENTS-HESTIA_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.23: What's cooking there this eve, dearie? Whatever we damn well please, that's what!
HADESANCIENTS-HESTIA_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.24: Well now I reckon it's time to fan the flames a bit, isn't it then?
HADESANCIENTS-HESTIA_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.25: I've been cooking up a little something special just for you, hot stuff!
HADESANCIENTS-HESTIA_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.26: Is something burning over there, dearie? Well it's about to be!
HADESANCIENTS-HESTIA_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.27: Let's keep that everlasting flame alive and well, what say you, hot stuff?
HADESANCIENTS-HESTIA_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.28: Well at least we're living in exciting times, I'll give us that!
HADESANCIENTS-HESTIA_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.29: What say we add a little fuel to this fire we've got going, why don't we?
HADESANCIENTS-HESTIA_ANCIENT.talk.firstV: Well, look at you, hot stuff! Come to help the elderly, ah what a good {:gendered:boy|girl|kid} you are. And here I was just about to burn this whole blasted place to the ground myself! Now, here's a little warm-up for ya...
